title: Normality of Varieties of Minimal Rational Tangents
original_scope: Complex projective manifold, locally unsplit dominating rational-curve component, general ambient point; no degree-minimization hypothesis.
proof_dependency: Published geometric existence and tangent-map theorems, plus the elementary normalization and genus arguments in REPORT.md.
remaining_gap: No gap in rejecting the universal assertion conditional on the cited published theorems. Their complete proofs are not rederived here.

queue_recommendation.Findings: Casagrande–Druel (2015), Thms. 1.9–1.10 and Ex. 5.8: nonnormal plane-sextic VMRT with genus-7 normalization, fitting the exact locally-unsplit codimension-one scope. Hwang–Kim (2015), Thm. 1.3: also false for unsplit degree-minimal Picard-one families (n=6,d=3).
